# M7 eject (SPEC Sec 2.5, T-205; T-0.3): a module that imports the virtual
# comptime package ejects to plain Go. main.lgo uses comptime.ViewAs and a
# const for comptime generic with a grouped import; names/names.lgo uses
# const for with an ungrouped import. The ejected tree drops every comptime
# import, runs under plain go with the output logos run prints, and stays
# vet- and gofmt-clean.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

# logos runs the module before eject.
logos run .
stdout '^header 1 2$'
stdout '^fields \[X Y\]$'
stdout '^names \[Left Right\]$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

# Snapshot the source tree; eject must never write into it (#112).
mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cp names/names.lgo $WORK/orig/names.lgo

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/names/names.go

# No ejected file imports comptime, and no bare import keyword is left.
! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/names/names.go
! grep '^import$' out/names/names.go

# The ejected tree runs under plain go with identical output.
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

# The source tree is unchanged after eject (#112).
cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cmp names/names.lgo $WORK/orig/names.lgo

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectct

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ejectct/names"
)

type Header struct {
	Magic   uint32
	Version uint32
}

type Pair struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func Names[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func main() {
	b := []byte{1, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0}
	h := comptime.ViewAs[Header](b)
	fmt.Println("header", h.Magic, h.Version)
	fmt.Println("fields", Names[Pair]())
	fmt.Println("names", names.Sides())
}

-- m/names/names.lgo --
package names

import "comptime"

type Side struct {
	Left  int
	Right int
}

func Sides() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Side]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}
